useWhen: Prepare one learning-material draft using BRIEF, CITE and SAFETY gates; use for owner-reviewed educational content.
avoidWhen: Publishing or promoting a draft to approved status

inputs.stage: owner draft state and write scope

outputs.draft: one draft plus source and safety review evidence

authority.binding: caller authorization and owner-reviewed target repository policy

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; wildcard versions do not establish installation or runtime qualification. Bind source dependencies and effective permissions in the owning repository.
